text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're on our way home from a day out, and I'm hoping to get back early enough to prepare for tomorrow's training. However…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Munch… Munch… Mmm! No cap, this is the best!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wow! That chunky beef burger was crazy! They couldn't even fit it in the bun!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What should we eat next? Kilimanjaro fries? Or how about the jumbo apple pie?
choice_data_list: I was thinking we should head home soon.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What? But we're just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I mean, come on! You said eating like this is fine every once in a while, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sure enough, that is what I said back when we first met…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So let's do it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems my hands are tied, so I decide to allow a little indulgence, but…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa! This is the thing everyone's talking about! Carrot Cornucopia!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, there's samples? Nice! Yes, please!
choice_data_list: Okay, after you've tried this one, we're—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rrrrring! Rrrrring!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh! Perfect timing! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wahey!

text_block_list.name: Helios and Palmer
text_block_list.text: Waheeey!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You know I gots to invite my peeps if they're nearby! That's a no-brainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, sorry for surprising you. I know it's really sudden, so just let us know if it's too much trouble…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No worries! It's fine! Now, let's start off with a selfie and then… a dance battle! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hello! I've come to hang out!

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text: Oh, hi, Jordan! ♪ I could use some help if you want an extra shift!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, sorry! It's my day off today! More importantly, you've got that new item in, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I've had my eyes on it for sooo long! I have to get it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, is there another new one?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wooow, I am so buying it! Hold my bags, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: By the time we make it back to the academy, the sun has already gone down.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm literally dyiiiinnng!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I can't even take another step… What's up with me?
choice_data_list: You need to rest for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Phew… I was scared there for a sec. Going all out like this used to be nothing for me…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Is that why? You're kidding, right? That's crazy.
choice_data_list: You're not supposed to shop until you actually drop.
You're not supposed to shop until you actually drop.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh, c'mon. I just wanna make the most of life, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I won't be able to have fun like this when I'm an adult.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: See! Thought so! Being an adult sounds like a total drag.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Let me know if you ever wanna blow off some steam! That's my specialty!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ha, there it is. Adults like that are just, like… you know? It's like…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Life's no fun if you live like that.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmm… If you say so.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm gonna drag you around like this again sometime. We'll call it an emotional anti-aging treatment or whatever.
